summary: Sh. Ali Mashhour continues his discussion on prayer timings, focusing on the importance of praying at the beginning of prayer times rather than delaying unnecessarily. He explains that while delaying prayer until the end of its time window is technically permissible, it is discouraged and considered dangerous spiritually. Sh. Ali Mashhour presents two hadith narrations emphasizing the Prophet's practice and encouragement to pray immediately when the time enters, noting that the Prophet's habit was to pray Maghrib as soon as the sun's disc disappeared from the horizon. He also addresses an extreme misinterpretation where some believers pray prayers back-to-back immediately after each other, clarifying that there must be sufficient time between the adhan and prayer for proper preparation, ablution, and the prescribed duas.
suggested_title: The Importance of Praying at the Beginning of Prayer Times
catchy_title: Why delay prayer when the time has entered?
